registryBasis: The official Kismayo Nagaad RAP states that Kismayo Municipality will process Jubaland title deeds for affected residents and describes municipal land-administration responsibilities and escalation through the Land Committee and Mayor's office. This evidences a local land-registration/title-deed procedure, not an open parcel geometry service or title conclusion.
